summary: 动名词具有名词性质，可作主语、宾语、表语和介词宾语，表示抽象、习惯性动作。

rules.title: 作主语与表语
rules.detail: 动名词短语作主语谓语用单数；表语说明主语的内容。

examples.en: Reading aloud is a good way to learn English.
examples.zh: 朗读是学英语的好方法。

rules.title: 只接动名词的动词与短语
rules.detail: admit, avoid, consider, delay, deny, enjoy, escape, finish, imagine, keep, mind, miss, practice, risk, suggest + doing；be worth doing；can't help doing；be busy doing；look forward to / devote to / be used to / object to + doing（to 是介词）。

examples.en: Would you mind opening the window?
I'm looking forward to hearing from you.
The novel is worth reading again.
examples.zh: 这部小说值得再读一遍。

rules.title: 介词后一律用动名词
rules.detail: be good at / be afraid of / instead of / succeed in / apologize for + doing。

examples.en: She is good at solving problems.

pitfalls: look forward to 后接 to do：❌ look forward to see you → ✓ look forward to seeing you（to 是介词）
be used to do 与 be used to doing 混淆：前者「被用来做」，后者「习惯于做」
suggest/advise 后接 to do：❌ suggest to go → ✓ suggest going

questions.stem: We should avoid ___ too much time on mobile phones.
questions.explain: avoid 后只接动名词 spending。

questions.stem: The old man is used to ___ early in the morning.
questions.explain: be used to doing = 习惯于做，to 是介词。
谚语 Seeing is believing（眼见为实），动名词作主语。
be worth doing 固定搭配，用动名词。
介词 for 后用动名词 being。

questions.stem: Instead of ___ (complain), we should take action.
questions.explain: instead of 中 of 是介词，后接动名词。

questions.stem: She suggested to hold a class meeting to discuss the problem.
在阳光下看书对眼睛有害。（翻译整句）
answer: reading in the sun is bad for your eyes.
reading books in the sun is bad for the eyes.
questions.explain: 动名词短语作主语；be bad for 对……有害。

questions.stem: 他习惯于每天查字典。（翻译整句）
answer: he is used to looking up words in the dictionary every day.
he is used to consulting the dictionary every day.
questions.explain: be used to doing 习惯于做；look up 查阅。
